record.one_liner: Freshdesk is a cloud helpdesk and customer support ticketing product from Freshworks.
record.auth_notes: Docs say the personal API key is sent as the Basic-auth username (curl -u apikey:X) with any dummy password. API key is found under Profile settings in the Support Portal.
record.access_notes: Every new account starts with a 14-day trial with full access to all product features. The free Sprout plan has no API access; API access is available from the Blossom plan onwards, so ongoing use needs a paid plan.
record.api_notes: REST API v2 with Basic-auth API key; examples use endpoints such as /api/v2/tickets. Rate limits vary by plan.
record.blocker_notes: Trial path gives API access for building and testing. Production use needs a paid plan (Blossom or higher) after the trial. The official MCP article is labelled EAP and uses an API-key-only endpoint at https://<subdomain>.freshdesk.com/mcp.
